all 13 orphaned entries are reverse_missing_forward findings pointing at deleted ZZ-*TEST fixture tickets created under a retired environment (env_id ade0f2ef-...) and archived 2026-06-26

the operator decided to delete the 13 orphaned reverse keys outright rather than tombstone them, and the repair was executed through BindingStore library and commit_and_push_tickets_branch with no ad-hoc git
